scenario: ISSUE DS-03 — a service `kwarg` (or schema slot) named after a reserved control-plane call/emit modifier (`retain` / `cooldown` / `nocooldown` / `as`) is intercepted as the modifier at the call/emit site and its value silently dropped. Reserve the names against binding-target declarations so the collision is a declaration-time error, not silent data loss. Pin: a service declaring `kwarg retain:` is DS_VALIDATE_RESERVED_META_KWARG.
rules_ds:
service mqtt.publish:
    kwarg topic: String required
    kwarg retain: Bool
    no response
